tasks.final_text: I recently went to a pizza place in Brighton (UK) called Pommys. It was a small out-of-the-way kinda place, and never having been there before I was a little skeptical. However, my daughter and I went in and ordered. Service was relatively quick but the pizza was.... AMAZING! I've eaten a LOT of pizz in my life but this was like nothing else (and I've eaten pizza in New York too!).

Shopper's World is an open-air shopping center in Framinham, Massachusetts. The original facility (spelled Shoppers' World) is of historical significance as one of the first suburban shopping malls in the United States upon opening in 1951; though it had a central courtyard and covered walkways, it was not fully outdoor.
